edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as ceoAddress in the CommonEth constructor.
NFToken constructor grants CFO and COO to msg.sender.
onlyCEO compares msg.sender against ceoAddress.
onlyCFO compares msg.sender against cfoAddress.
onlyCOO compares msg.sender against cooAddress.
onlyLiveMode lets staff bypass the LIVE mode restriction.
onlyOwnerOf checks ownerOf(_tokenId) equals msg.sender.
joinCarveUpTen authorization relies on msg.sender ownership and live mode.
buy is callable by any msg.sender while in LIVE mode.
withdrawContractEther is restricted by msg.sender as CFO.
msg.sender is used to claim ownership after the approval check.
msg.sender is passed as _from in transfer.
staffInfo returns comparisons of msg.sender with staff addresses.
now drives the carve-up timing and loser selection inside joinCarveUpTen.
require(token.openTime < now) gates buy on block.timestamp.
now is stored as currentTime when creating a token.
theLoserIndex is computed from digits of block.timestamp.
buy performs an external ether transfer to ownerOf(_id).
Ownership state is only changed after the external payout in buy.
A malicious recipient can re-enter buy before ownership and price are settled.
joinCarveUpTen loops external ether transfers to each winner.
A recipient fallback can re-enter joinCarveUpTen during settlement.
carveUpTokens is reset only after all external payouts complete.
carverUpIndex is advanced after the external payout loop.
withdrawContractEther sends ether to cfoAddress externally.
The cfoAddress transfer can re-enter withdrawal with a stale balance.
buy scales token.price by a rate constant and divides by 100.
RISE_RATE is consumed by the price escalation arithmetic.
RISE_RATE_FAST is consumed by the price escalation arithmetic.
__createNewToken computes id as totalSupply() + 1.
The new id is derived directly from totalTokens and can collide or overflow.
addToken increments supply using SafeMath.add.
removeToken decrements supply using SafeMath.sub.
SafeMath.add result is written back to totalTokens.
SafeMath.sub result is written back to totalTokens.
SALE_FEE_RATE feeds the bonus and seller-payout arithmetic in buy.
withdrawal guard subtracts carverUpIndex * CARVE_UP_INPUT from the balance.
withdrawAbleEther subtracts the reserved carve-up input from the balance.
The reserved amount depends on the mutable carverUpIndex.
onlyOwnerOf calls ownerOf to validate ownership.
transfer is guarded by onlyOwnerOf.
transfer delegates the move to clearApprovalAndTransfer.
approve is guarded by onlyOwnerOf.
approve reads ownerOf(_tokenId).
approve reads approvedFor(_tokenId).
takeOwnership checks isApprovedFor(msg.sender, _tokenId).
takeOwnership resolves the current owner via ownerOf.
takeOwnership finalizes the move through clearApprovalAndTransfer.
_mint registers the token through addToken.
_burn clears an existing approval before removal.
_burn removes the token via removeToken.
_burn is guarded by onlyOwnerOf.
isApprovedFor compares approvedFor with the given owner.
clearApprovalAndTransfer verifies the caller through ownerOf.
clearApprovalAndTransfer clears the approval first.
clearApprovalAndTransfer removes the token from the sender.
clearApprovalAndTransfer adds the token to the receiver.
clearApproval verifies ownership via ownerOf.
addToken reads balanceOf(_to) for the index.
